# Sensitive paths — the single source of truth for the guardrail model (D-047, PD-308).
#
# A PR whose diff touches any glob below turns the `path-guard` check RED unless a write+
# collaborator applies the `sensitive-change-approved` label. Editing a sensitive path is never
# forbidden — it just requires a conscious human ack. That friction IS the control.
#
# Consumed by Tier 1 (the path-guard workflow, .github/workflows/path-guard.yml) and, once it
# ships, by Tier 2 (PD-312 generates Claude Code deny rules from this same file).
#
# SYNTAX: one git pathspec glob per line; `#` comments and blank lines ignored. Each line is
# passed to `git diff` as `:(glob)<line>`, so matching is git's own documented glob semantics —
# `**` crosses directory boundaries, and `**/x` matches `x` at the repo root too. Verified:
# `**/package.json` matches the root `package.json` as well as every workspace one.
#
# SELF-PROTECTING: `.github/**` covers both this file and the guard workflow, so a PR that tries
# to weaken the guard trips the guard. The check runs from the BASE branch (pull_request_target),
# so the PR's own version of these files never evaluates itself.
#
# NOTE: drawn against the current NAS/Docker-on-Synology layout. PD-311 re-evaluates the list
# after the Mac Mini migration (PD-188).

# ── CI, deploy, and ops ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.github/**
ops/**
docker/**
**/Dockerfile
**/docker-compose*.yml

# ── Secrets and environment ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
**/.env*

# ── Database schema and migrations ───────────────────────────────────────────
**/schema.ts
apps/server/src/migrate.ts

# ── Agent harness config ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.claude/**

# ── Dependency manifests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# This is the pair PR #268 changed with no enforcement — the incident behind PD-308.
**/package.json
package-lock.json

# ── Forward-looking ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# No auth today (LAN-only, no auth), but listed now so the guard is already in place
# if/when the reverse proxy lands and the board becomes reachable off-LAN.
**/auth/**
**/session/**
**/*cors*
**/*csp*
